problems.name: muse_bf16_proj
problems.summary: The attention and MoE-block projections and the router, as one GPU runs them serving Muse Spark Open on 8×H200. They are BF16 (the router FP32).
problems.title: Dense projections

problems.name: muse_attention_decode
problems.summary: One decode step or 8-token verify block of grouped-query attention over a paged FP8 cache: QK-norm, a 2,048-token sliding window with RoPE or full attention over the whole context, and a gated, normalized output.
problems.title: Gated attention decode

problems.name: muse_moe_w4a16
problems.summary: Top-8 of 256 experts at width 4096: SwiGLU, NVFP4 weights, and a norm on each expert’s output before it is weighted and summed.
problems.title: Routed experts

problems.name: muse_decode_layer
problems.summary: Everything one GPU does for one layer of Muse Spark Open under TP8/EP8: the projections, attention, the router and experts, and every norm and residual in between.
problems.title: Whole decoder layer

problems.name: muse_prefill_layer
problems.summary: The whole decoder layer at the prefill shapes of an agentic coding turn: 753 new tokens on an 80K-token conversation, four conversations at once, and the first turn’s 16K-token chunks. Most of the time goes to the routed experts, as one large grouped NVFP4 GEMM.
problems.title: Prefill layer
